EVAL001.JPG.description: A northern harrier (Circus hudsonius) glides gracefully in flight over a rural landscape during the warm light of golden hour.

EVAL002.JPG.description: A close-up of likely Mona Lavender spurflower (Plectranthus 'Mona Lavender') blooming with delicate purple flowers against a backdrop of lush green leaves.

EVAL003.JPG.description: A flock of American avocets (Recurvirostra americana) in non-breeding plumage forage in the water alongside female Greater Scaup.

EVAL004.JPG.description: A scenic view of Donnell Reservoir nestled within the granite cliffs from the Donnell Vista on Sonora Pass Hwy 108, California, surrounded by pine trees under a blue sky.

EVAL005.JPG.description: An abstract zoom burst photograph of a waterfall cascading down dark rocks, on the trail towarss Sardine Falls, creating a dynamic radial motion blur effect with muted green and blue tones.

EVAL006.JPG.description: A mountain stream flows through a lush meadow bordered by likely willows (Salix) and big sagebrush (Artemisia tridentata), with branches laid to make a bridge.

EVAL007.JPG.description: Gondola cabins ascend Mammoth Mountain seen through scratched windows, surrounded by pine trees and snow-dusted peaks.

EVAL008.JPG.description: Distinctive limestone tufa towers rise from the blue waters of Mono Lake, California, with mountains in the background under a clear sky.

EVAL009.JPG.description: An Osprey (Pandion haliaetus) nest, with young Osprey sits atop a tufa tower under a clear blue sky, at Mono Lake, California, with a Purple-green Swallow (Hirundo pyrrhonota) perched nearby.

EVAL010.JPG.description: A Brewer's sparrow (Spizella breweri) perches atop a sagebrush shrub (Artemisia tridentata) with its beak open in song.

EVAL011.JPG.description: Twin Falls cascades down a forested hillside into Twin Lakes in Mammoth Lakes, California, surrounded by lodgepole pines (Pinus contorta).

EVAL012.JPG.description: A deep volcanic fissure near Seven Lakes Point Loop near Mammoth Lakes, California, surrounded by lodgepole pines (*Pinus contorta*) and distant mountains.

EVAL013.JPG.description: A likely California evening primrose (*Oenothera californica*) blooms amidst dry grasses and sandy soil next to a granite boulder.

EVAL014.JPG.description: A scenic view of Half Dome rising above a dense pine forest under a clear blue sky in Yosemite National Park, California, from Olmsted Point.

EVAL015.JPG.description: A vibrant mountain pride (Penstemon newberryi) wildflower blooms from a granite crevice in Yosemite National Park, with Half Dome visible in the background, from Olmsted Point.

EVAL016.JPG.description: A scenic view of Upper Yosemite Falls cascading down a massive granite cliff face in Yosemite National Park, California, framed by evergreen trees.

EVAL017.JPG.description: A view of El Capitan from Taft Point in Yosemite National Park, California, with visitors standing on the rocky cliff edge under a clear blue sky.

EVAL018.JPG.description: A likely common raven (Corvus corax) takes flight from a rocky outcrop against a clear blue sky.

EVAL019.JPG.description: A vibrant red snow plant (Sarcodes sanguinea) emerges from the bark and debris of a shaded forest floor.

EVAL020.JPG.description: A bracket fungus, likely a red-banded polypore (*Fomitopsis pinicola*), grows on the deeply furrowed bark of a large conifer tree in a sunny forest.

EVAL021.JPG.description: A scenic view of Half Dome in Yosemite National Park, California, framed by evergreen trees under a clear blue sky.

EVAL022.JPG.description: A one-seeded pussy paws (Calyptridium monospermum) plant with pink and white flower clusters grows in dry, rocky soil.

EVAL023.JPG.description: An aerial high-angle view of Vernal Fall cascading over a granite cliff surrounded by dense pine forests in Yosemite National Park, California.

EVAL024.JPG.description: A vintage steam locomotive, number 10, sits inside a wooden engine shed on a heritage railway track at Yosemite Mountain Sugar Pine Railroad.

EVAL025.JPG.description: An American red squirrel (Tamiasciurus hudsonicus) stands alert on a fallen tree branch in a forest.

EVAL026.JPG.description: Steam rises from the dark, greasy mechanical parts and pipes of a vintage steam engine at Yosemite Mountain Sugar Pine Railroad.

EVAL027.JPG.description: An elevated view of the historic McNear Brickyard on the shores of San Pablo Bay in San Rafael, California, under an overcast, foggy sky.

EVAL028.JPG.description: The peak of Mount Tamalpais is partially shrouded in low-lying clouds and fog under a blue sky.

EVAL029.JPG.description: Several purple flowers of coyote mint (Monardella villosa) bloom amidst dry, golden grasses in a summer field.

EVAL030.JPG.description: An osprey (Pandion haliaetus) flies across a pale, overcast sky.

EVAL031.JPG.description: Several Snowy Egrets (Egretta thula) are perched within the green foliage of a tree canopy.

EVAL032.JPG.description: A snowy egret (Egretta thula), a great egret (Ardea alba), and a western gull (Larus occidentalis) gather near fishing nets on a wooden dock.

EVAL033.JPG.description: The Richmond-San Rafael Bridge spans the San Francisco Bay under an overcast sky, with oil tankers anchored nearby and the Oakland skyline in muted tones.

EVAL034.JPG.description: A distant view of the San Francisco skyline, including the Salesforce Tower and Transamerica Pyramid, framed by the rolling hills of the Marin Headlands.

EVAL035.JPG.description: A wild bobcat (Lynx rufus) with a bird in its mouth, walks along a grassy path overlooking Tennessee Beach.

EVAL036.JPG.description: An aerial view of the Sphere in Las Vegas, Nevada, displaying a giant yellow emoji face, surrounded by city buildings and parking lots.

EVAL037.JPG.description: A western gull (Larus occidentalis) scavenges on a crab carcass on a sandy beach near the ocean shoreline.

EVAL038.JPG.description: A scenic view of the Golden Gate Bridge and the San Francisco skyline across the blue bay, framed by Monterey cypress (Cupressus macrocarpa) trees in the foreground.

EVAL039.JPG.description: A Kildeer anda couple of Least Sandpipers stand on algae-covered rocks in a tide pool area with ocean waves in the background.

EVAL040.JPG.description: A gopher snake (Pituophis catenifer) slithers across dry, rocky dirt ground covered with scattered leaves.

EVAL041.JPG.description: A street musician, Robert Culbertson, plays a Chapman Stick under a canopy tent during an outdoor performance.
